command.name: security key-manager external sync-key-cache
command.description: The (privilege: diagnostic) security key-manager external sync-key-cache command enables cluster administrators to manually post a job to Job Manager to synchronize the external key cache with a specified primary external key server associated with any Vserver. When running the security key-manager external sync-key-cache command for the external key manager associated with the admin Vserver, you must run the same command on the peer cluster. When running the security key-manager external sync-key-cachecommand for a data Vserver, you can run the command on the active cluster only as the command is replicated on the peer cluster.

parameter.name: vserver
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the Vserver on which to synchronize the external key cache.

parameter.name: key-server
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the key management server for which the command synchronizes the external key cache.

parameter.name: remove-stale-objects
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify if the stale objects for the given key server are to be removed from the external key cache. The default value is true.

example.p: In the following example, a cluster administrator triggers key cache synchronization for the key server at IP address 10.0.0.10 with the default port of 5696. This would also clear the stale entries from the cache.
example.screen: cluster-1::*> security key-manager external sync-key-cache -vserver cluster-1 -key-server 10.0.0.10
